# RAVN UI

Minimal, premium, CDN-first UI library inspired by DaisyUI and shadcn/ui. Designed for building elite SaaS dashboards in minutes without Tailwind, build steps, or bloat.

## Philosophy
- **No Build Steps**: Works directly in the browser via CDN.
- **No Tailwind**: Pure, semantic CSS classes.
- **Premium Aesthetics**: High-density, high-fidelity design out of the box.
- **SPA Ready**: Built-in utilities for view-switching and sidebar management.

## Core Components
- **Layout**: `.layout-shell`, `.layout-sidebar`, `.layout-main`, `.layout-header`, `.layout-content`.
- **UI**: `.card`, `.btn`, `.table`, `.avatar`, `.badge`, `.skeleton`, `.breadcrumb`, `.metrics-grid`.
- **States**: `.active`, `.disabled`, `.sidebar-collapsed` (on body).

## Layout Utilities
- **Flexbox**: `.flex`, `.items-center`, `.justify-between`, `.flex-wrap`.
- **Grid**: `.grid`, `.grid-2`, `.grid-3`.
- **Spacing**: `.gap-1` to `.gap-12`, `.mt-*`, `.mb-*`, etc.
- **Typography**: `.text-sm`, `.text-muted`, `.font-bold`.

## Javascript API (RAVN)
- `RAVN.view(targetId)`: Swaps the active view (elements with `data-view`).
- `RAVN.toggleSidebar()`: Toggles the `.sidebar-collapsed` class on the body.
- `RAVN.showToast(message)`: Displays a notification (if implemented).

## Directory Structure (Recommended)
- `index.html`: Main entry point.
- `assets/css/app.css`: Custom user styles.
- `assets/js/app.js`: Custom app logic.
- `pages/`: Sub-pages and secondary views.
- `functions/`: Reusable Javascript utilities.

## CDN Links
- CSS: `https://unpkg.com/@ravn-ui/core/dist/ui.css`
- Themes: `https://unpkg.com/@ravn-ui/core/dist/themes.css`
- JS: `https://unpkg.com/@ravn-ui/core/dist/ui.js`
